item.tib: rdzogs chen don gyis ngo spod
item.coloph: de ltar bka' yi gdams pa 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / rig 'dzin rje la mthol lo bshags/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams gyis bdag sogs phyi rabs gang zag rnams/ rdzogs pa chen po mthar thugs bon/ skad cig nyid la rtogs gyur nas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med ye rdzogs shog kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bstan pa bon gyi rgyal mtshan tshugs/ nub pa med pa'i bkra shis shog/
